# Core verifier violations the core corpus test (`//src:core_corpus_test`)
# accepts for now. One entry per line: `<rule> <module> <function>  # <reason>`,
# with `-` for the function of a static. A module or function ending in `*`
# matches by prefix (`forget*` covers every instance of `forget`; `*` covers
# every name). Remove an entry once it is fixed.

# The checker records no generic arguments for a call to an instance, so a
